description: Standing, zero expected: no push to main without a policy evaluation. Each run names its push range, and the ranges must chain from the gate's first run to main's head

matrix_rows.gap: The project pushes to main rather than merging pull requests, so each push is evaluated once it lands, not before: a failing evaluation is a finding to fix or except before the change is applied, not a blocked merge.

Static analysis of the infrastructure only -- Trivy and the authored rules over every push's plans; the application code has no static analyser. There are no merges; every push to main is what is evaluated.
